title: dendropanax oliganthus
intro: Dendropanax oliganthus, commonly known as Japanese angelica tree, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Dendropanax oliganthus include lignans, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
